finalText:
Common cause: pass new object/array/function literal each render (inline `{}`, `[]`, arrow func). New reference each time, so child prop check fail even if content same.

Fix, pick fit:
- Wrap component in `React.memo(Child)` — shallow compare props.
- Memoize object/array with `useMemo`.
- Memoize function with `useCallback`.

Example:

```jsx
// bad: new object + new function every render
<Child style={{color: 'red'}} onClick={() => doThing(id)} />

// good
const style = useMemo(() => ({color: 'red'}), []);
const onClick = useCallback(() => doThing(id), [id]);
<Child style={style} onClick={onClick} />
```

Also check: parent re-render alone don't cause child re-render if child wrapped `React.memo` and props stable. No memo = child re-render on every parent render regardless of props.
